full.description: This is a light micrograph of heart muscle tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin. The section shows myocardial fibers surrounding a small blood vessel or capillary. Within the vessel lumen, there is a prominent microthrombus characteristic of thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (TTP). Surrounding interstitial changes and microvascular occlusion are also visible. The overall appearance is consistent with cardiac involvement in TTP.
